pub(super) fn normalize_associated_types_in<T>(
        &self,
        span: Span,
        body_id: hir::HirId,
        param_env: ty::ParamEnv<'tcx>,
        value: T,
    ) -> T
    where
        T: TypeFoldable<'tcx>,
    {
        self.normalize_associated_types_in_with_cause(
            ObligationCause::misc(span, body_id),
            param_env,
            value,
        )
    }
